findings.title: Outcome success binding retains an unrelated outer parameter's patch footprint
findings.cause: parameter_written only visits statement bindings/assignments and If/Match blocks; it does not discover OutcomeMatch success bindings inside expressions. expression(OutcomeMatch) flattens all arm bodies into children and recursively passes the unchanged outer parameters slice. patch_bound then finds the outer same-named StatusOnlyPatch parameter and proves disjointness from its fields, although type inference has shadowed that name with a DuePatch containing due_at.
findings.source_counterpart: semantic/typecheck.rs infer_expression(OutcomeMatch) explicitly clones the environment and inserts Success binding -> subject type per arm. The hook census does not mirror this scope change or reject its unknown origin.

reproduction.surrounding_source: Real discovered golden-todo-migration source plus current test-owned delivery fixture, with only historical message key replaced in memory as in Main's fixture tests. StatusOnlyPatch/DuePatch declarations appended to contracts; helper functions in test-owned fixture path; extra action inserted in actual Todo owner body. No repository source was changed.
reproduction.comparison_controls: An unshadowed extra DuePatch update and the same outcome arm without an outer changes parameter both produce HOOK_INVALID. Baseline produces only the guard. Direct parameter shadowing/rebinding also produces HOOK_INVALID.
reproduction.current_export: All cases have zero ordinary checked delivery jobs and derive_approval_subject refuses; unconditional guard is intact.

findings.impact: A real extra due_at mutation outside the named patch hook is not counted. Future schedule-revision/sent-clear hooks would be incomplete if TBP02 were accepted and the later complete binding guard removed on this census. This is a present structural-prerequisite miss, not a claim of current worker execution or usable authority.
findings.smallest_safe_correction: Visit each OutcomeMatch arm with a scope-aware parameter-origin environment. At minimum, remove any outer parameter shadowed by Success(binding) before recursively visiting that arm's value/reject fields, so patch provenance is unknown and rejects. Do not aggregate arm bodies under a common unchanged parameter slice. Make any conservative parameter-shadow helper recursively account for outcome bindings and nested expression scopes as applicable; no general alias/control-flow solver is needed.

assessment.direct_hook_sites: Unique compatible top-level Binding(Attempt(Create/Update)) sites in exact qualified owned Actions are allowlisted by source/range internal addresses. Naming a callable never exempts its whole body. Open enum construction, unsent none and direct due parameter field/type are checked for create; exact selected optional patch field, same parameter, conditional none supplied guard and absence of competing explicit/transition changes are checked for patch. Parameter renames preserve these relationships.
assessment.source_walk: All Expression variants and Statement variants have a census branch. Reviewed roots include root and lowered owned callables, inline routes and route run expressions, tests, record lifecycle initial/transition/visibility/from/purge expressions, fixtures/config/service fake values, job arguments and authentication setting/active expressions. Record/enum/config defaults and scalar constraints are literals/type references, not hidden expression-bearing roots in this AST. Generated bound fields and lifecycle-bound writes reject. The OutcomeMatch scope defect is distinct from merely visiting its arm expression.
assessment.disjoint_status_delete: Explicit/conditional due/sent changes, effective direct patch record fields and checked transition sets are counted; unknown/multisegment/local-alias patch provenance rejects. Disjoint status-only direct patch and existing delete/status transitions remain accepted in baseline tests. Following record aliases is cycle-safe; whole-type aliases themselves remain unsupported by ordinary TYPE_PATCH_NOT_INPUT in the independent controls and are not claimed clean positives.
